text: Ultimate limit state combinations shall be per EN 1990 equation 6.10 (or 6.10a / 6.10b), with the partial factors and psi factors of the National Annex and category E / F imposed load factors for industrial areas. The seismic combination shall be per TBDY 2018 with EN 1990 equation 6.12b: G + psi2 x Q + E, psi2 = 0.6 for storage, laydown and equipment areas.
